message.content:
One of the most iconic and widely recognized sculptures of the 19th century is **“The Kiss” by Auguste Rodin** (1889).  
It was originally conceived as part of his monumental “Gates of Hell” project, but the bronze pair of lovers became a standalone masterpiece that has been reproduced in countless editions and is celebrated worldwide for its sensual realism and emotional depth.
